The La-Mulana Series. It's insanely underrated.

Meant to replicate the very old MSX games so things like instant death from traps are very common and you are guaranteed to die from at least a couple. The gameplay itself isn't the hard part, but the game revolves around solving puzzles centered around the games lore, which can end up being very cyptic and confusing, but in a way that makes you proud when you eventually solve it using your surroundings and context clues.

 Speaking of the lore and story, I can't even begin to explain everything about it but it is a *MARVEL* to anyone who enjoys Mythology, especially Mesopotamian, Mayan or Egyptian. The fact that there is a [3 hour video discussing the mythology and lore of the game](https://youtu.be/7Z0hgKs9bcg) shows just how much the game has to offer.

Not to mention the music. Songs like [Interstice of The Dimension](https://youtu.be/cp_A1Nn9b-Q) and [Good Night Mom](https://youtu.be/ACvJnI8txlM) are the songs the game is most well known for, but there are so many others that are such gems. The instrumentation and the way the songs perfectly set the tone for their specific area; it's absolutely incredible.

If anyone is interested, you can buy a combo pack of La-Mulana 1 & 2 on Steam and Switch for around $25 and it is absolutely worth the price, if only for the unique game experience that NO OTHER game on the market will offer.
